Container.Name: Wake Hub
Container.Overview: Self-hosted LAN power control: Wake-on-LAN, Synaccess PDU, Intel AMT, JetKVM, Shelly, Kasa and CyberPower UPS, with a web UI, REST API and MCP server on one port. Host networking is required so magic packets and ARP scans reach the LAN.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User that owns the appdata files

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group that owns the appdata files

Config.Name: Web Port
Config.Description: Port for the web UI, REST API and MCP. Host networking means this is a host port.

Config.Name: Secret key
Config.Description: Optional encryption key. Leave empty to generate /config/secret.key

Config.Name: CORS origins
Config.Description: Comma-separated browser origins allowed to call the API, or *

Container.Requires: Use host networking. Bridge mode cannot deliver directed broadcasts or ARP.
